column1: # Static crash corpus, replayed by tests/replay.rs. One crash point per line.
# expect=ok: either valid prefix (ok_acked or ok_acked_plus_one). Other values must match exactly.
# Faithful rows: every crash point whose reopened state was not simply the acknowledged one
# (in-flight commit visible, or no commit acknowledged yet). Control rows (lying_sync=1): one sample of each
# failing verdict, proving the oracle still fails lost durability.
